notes.title: Shanghai-Nanking Release, PS4/5 Release, and New Future Campaign Poll!
notes.notes:
[h1]Hello all![/h1]

It’s a big day today. The newest DLC is out, the PlayStation 4/5 version is out, and the poll to decide the next campaign is now live! Let’s go over everything now.

[h1]Shanghai - Nanking Campaign[/h1]

Our newest DLC, Easy Red 2: Shanghai-Nanking, is live right now to be [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3499380/Easy_Red_2_Shanghai__Nanking/?curator_clanid=37973310]purchased and played on Steam![/url] It will take a few weeks to be released to Xbox and Nintendo Switch, and a few more weeks to be approved and released for PlayStation. 

Shanghai - Nanking takes you to China in 1937 during the beginning months of the Second Sino-Japanese War, from the war-torn streets of downtown Shanghai to the cold, dead fields of the former Chinese capital city, Nanking. 

It includes:
[list]
[*]Shanghai (5x5 km) and Nanking (4x4 km) maps with 23 new missions total
[*]New Chinese faction 
[*]New Chinese and Japanese uniforms and kits, totaling more than 70 new clothing items
[*]New vehicles and aircraft, such as the Nakajima A4N, the Hawk-3, the Type 89 tank, the Vickers 6-ton tank, and the [*]Type 24 HMG. Also, the Chinese versions of the P40 Warhawk, Polikarpov I-16, T-26, Panzer 1, SdKfz 222, Vickers Crossley, and more…
[*]New weapons: Type 24 Rifle, Hanyang 88, ZB-26, Chinese MP-18, Sig20, FN Model D and more…
[*]Over 100 new beautiful map props and buildings to be used in the Mission and Map Editor
[/list]
[h2]Check out the new DLC [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3499380/Easy_Red_2_Shanghai__Nanking/?curator_clanid=37973310] here! [/url][/h2]

[previewyoutube=8VjKBlBBvKI;full][/previewyoutube]

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3499380/]You can wishlist the DLC now here![/url]
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3499380/Easy_Red_2_Shanghai__Nanking/

Thank to EndoSkull Gaming for the pre-release interview & gamplay!
[previewyoutube=fDuhaJKjGxg;full][/previewyoutube]

[h1]Playstation 4/5 Release[/h1] 

[b]Easy Red 2 will also be released on PlayStation Store at 10 AM of your local time![/b]

Currently, the build is cross-generation for both PlayStation 4 and 5, with improvements for PS5 over PS4 for the extra hardware. [i]A dedicated PlayStation 5 may come in the future for additional features.[/i]

Check out ER2 on the PlayStation store [url=https://store.playstation.com/it-it/concept/10011381] here! [/url]

[h1]Future Campaign Poll[/h1]

The newest DLC is now out, and it’s been a while since our last big poll– it’s time to hear the community’s thoughts on what the next big campaign for Easy Red 2 will be! 

With this poll, we’re using it to gauge community interest– not just the winner is taken into consideration. We will be considering all votes, and basing what we do in the future off of what your interest is in! 

Already planned this year are the [i]Kwajalein and Roi Namur Reworks[/i], the [i]Anzio Rework[/i], and the new [i]Southern Tunisia[/i] map to conclude the Tunisia campaign. After that… [i]who knows![/i] We’re very excited to see what you as the community have to say and we will follow up with the poll results in about a week on our official community discord server. You get up to three choices: pick your favorite!

[url=https://docs.google.com/forms/d/e/1FAIpQLSerlUnZ7I1Dd26oDYyEr4Qd4ZcyqSeScUtLGjh92lGlhFvrcw/viewform?usp=dialog] Vote in the new poll here [/url]

[h1]Extra informations[/h1]
In case you didn't know we have [url=https://steamcommunity.com/games/1324780/announcements/detail/3798284112488632792]defined a [b]precise roadmap for the next months[/b] of development and you can read it here.[/url]

We keep improving all features of the base game and as always we will be going on listening to suggestions from people inside the Steam Discussions and the  [url=https://discord.com/invite/ksfaFUfec3]Discord server[/url].

[h3]Thanks for reading, we’re looking forward to seeing the results of the poll![/h3]

[i]Marco + Corvostudio[/i]

We managed to make the first fully scripted mission in Easy Red 2: The Sihang Warehouse defense mission for the upcoming Shanghai-Nanking DLC.

[h1]TPS Animations Rework[/h1]
After putting in a significant amount of effort,[b] we have successfully revamped all of our uniforms[/b] for the TPS animations rework. The TPS Animation Rework aims to [b]enhance the quality of our game by remaking all the third-person-view and AI animations[/b]. This rework consists of several stages, and we have recently completed a major milestone: a complete overhaul of our uniforms, utilizing a more refined and optimized skeleton system. This new system will greatly improve the fluidity and flexibility of our animations.

Now [b]the focus is on creating new animations for this updated rig[/b]. It's worth noting that some of the older animations may appear slightly less polished on this new rig. However, we have already introduced new and improved animations for the no-weapon pose and the rifle pose, and [b]we have plans to introduce fresh animations on a weekly basis[/b] until all of the animations have been reworked.

It's important to recognize that while our primary focus is on reworking existing animations, once this phase is completed, we intend to incorporate new animations and systems into the game.


[h1]Uniform modding[/h1]
Thanks to the revamped TPS rig, [b]creating custom uniform mods for the game has become a straightforward process[/b].

[b]Designing uniform mods for the game is relatively easy[/b] compared to other aspects of modding. It also provides the flexibility to design uniforms with various features, such as long sleeves, short sleeves, or even those that completely cover the hands, such as gloves or creatures that require modeling of the entire arm and hand.

We spent a lot of time during last couple months trying to fix a bug that was making some user (normally RTX card user) getting weird crash issue when running on Direct X.
